explanation: A central attribute of God that involves care, devotion, and loyalty toward people.
The ability to keep promises and remain loyal to a person, especially in the relationship between God and humanity.
Actions or thoughts that break God's laws and moral standards, leading to separation from Him.
The consequences of sin, often expressed as suffering or misfortune, which God allows to correct and discipline people.
A strong expression of sorrow and regret over sin, showing the desire to turn back to God and live according to His will.
Understanding of God's will and plan, as well as insight into how to live a life in harmony with His purpose.
An attitude of modesty and respect toward God, where one acknowledges their own limitations and dependence on Him.
